About.title: SINCE
About.description:
Karya Electrical Engineering Company is a trusted provider of comprehensive electrical engineering solutions, delivering reliable, efficient, and innovative services across residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. With a strong foundation built on technical expertise and industry best practices, we are committed to meeting the evolving needs of our clients while maintaining the highest standards of safety and quality.
Our team of skilled engineers and technicians brings years of hands-on experience to every project, from electrical design and installation to maintenance, troubleshooting, and system upgrades. We pride ourselves on our attention to detail, timely project execution, and ability to deliver customized solutions that align with each client’s specific requirements.
At Karya Electrical Engineering Company, our mission is to build long-term partnerships through integrity, professionalism, and excellence. By embracing modern technologies and continuously improving our processes, we strive to power progress and contribute to sustainable, energy-efficient infrastructure for the future.
At Kayra Engineering, our strength lies in our people. Our team is made up of dedicated engineers, technicians, and project specialists who bring a strong blend of technical expertise, hands-on experience, and problem-solving mindset to every project. United by a commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement, we work collaboratively to deliver reliable engineering solutions while building lasting trust with our clients.

Policy.title: HSE Policy
Policy.text: Karya Engineering is dedicated to achieving excellence in Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) performance across all our operations. We believe that every incident is preventable and are committed to fostering a culture where safety is a core value. Our HSE policy is built on the principles of compliance with legal requirements, continuous improvement, and active engagement of all employees in HSE practices. We strive to minimize our environmental impact through sustainable practices and responsible resource management. By integrating HSE considerations into every aspect of our business, we aim to protect our people, communities, and the environment while delivering high-quality engineering solutions.

Culture.title: A Culture of Safety
Culture.textOne: We are fully committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace for our employees, and accident prevention is paramount. Our highly-trained Safety Professionals diligently work to create an Injury, Incident and Impact Free (I-3 Free) environment on every project. This I-3 Free culture permeates our entire organization, as we continuously work to eliminate risk. We place this value above all others and strive to provide our people with the tools, equipment and working conditions that will help them safely and efficiently do their very best work.
